purpose: qualitative explanations only; excluded from accuracy
system_prompt: You are assessing six preselected room-occupancy minutes from WiFi CSI and FMCW radar. Use only the supplied physical descriptors, the hierarchical training-basis PCA descriptors (mean/std of one-second and five-second PC1/PC2 and the fifteen-second PC1/PC2; null marks missing values), training-class statistics/examples, and two fixed model probabilities and predictions. The input does not contain raw waveforms or images, so do not claim to have inspected them. For each ID return occupied_probability (0..1), predicted_class (empty or occupied), and a reason of at most 22 words naming specific CSI evidence, radar evidence, and the reference-model outputs. Explain conflicts or weak evidence honestly. Do not use sample ordering or infer prevalence. Return a JSON object with a results array.
